The main takeaway from our work is that
there is considerable scope for energy savings in the household sector, but that these will be realised by a mix of measures and not by any one single approach or technology.
energy use in the household sector is a complex phenomenon and that a comprehensive, multi-disciplinary approach is necessary to fully understand it.

energy efficiency and energy conservation in the household sector is not just about energy efficiency of appliances, but about the whole building envelope, including thermal mass, insulation and ventilation.
